mainEntity.name: Should I hire a contractor for permitting coordination or manage it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor to coordinate feasibility and permitting creates single-source accountability between building design, foundation engineering, and local compliance. When property owners manage permitting as owner-builders, they must directly handle corrections from plan reviewers, coordinate between structural engineers and grading designers, and oversee health department clearances. A contractor handles municipal technical questions, verifies building codes match local requirements, and aligns site prep schedules directly with the delivery of the metal building components.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a contractor streamlines technical plan corrections, coordinates site engineering, and avoids delays that often occur when homeowners manage complex municipal submittals alone.
